edges.reason: msg.sender is the value checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
The constructor mints the total supply to the deployer.
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
msg.sender flows into the core transfer path.
distTokens uses msg.sender as the token source.
distTokens records block.timestamp as the locked time.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap swap deadline.
Constructor stores the Uniswap router reference.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair.
Constructor excludes owner and contract from fees.
_transfer triggers the contract token swap when thresholds are met.
_transfer forwards ETH to charity before completing the token movement.
Burn amount is computed with fee arithmetic.
Fee reflection performs the rTotal supply mutation.
Fee computation uses the tax fee.
Fee computation uses the charity fee.
Reflection rate is computed with a division.
Supply computation runs an unbounded loop.

sendETHToCharity reads the charity wallet address.

The external swap can re-enter the transfer path before balances are settled.
